turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: Over the past few months I’ve been feeling weaker than usual and I’ve had unintentional weight loss. I also had prior blood work that showed elevated BUN and creatinine.

How much weight have you lost, over what time period, and have you noticed a decreased appetite?
How much weight have you lost, over what time period, and have you noticed a decreased appetite?
Patient: I’ve lost about 10 pounds over the last two to three months, and I do think my appetite has been lower than usual. I’m not sure why, but the weakness has been steadily getting worse.
Have you had any nausea, vomiting, itching, swelling in your legs, shortness of breath, or changes in how much you urinate?
I haven’t had nausea or vomiting, and I don’t notice any itching or leg swelling. I also haven’t had any shortness of breath, and my urination seems about the same as usual.
Have you had fevers, night sweats, bone pain, back pain, or recurrent infections?

Patient: I haven’t had any fevers or night sweats, and I don’t recall any recurrent infections. I also haven’t had significant bone pain or new back pain—just the gradual worsening weakness and the weight loss.
Have you noticed blood in your urine, foamy urine, pain with urination, flank pain, or trouble starting your urine stream?
I haven’t noticed any blood in my urine, foamy urine, or pain with urination. I also haven’t had flank pain, or any trouble starting my urine stream—it feels about the same as usual.
Do you have a history of high blood pressure, diabetes, kidney disease, heavy NSAID use, or any new medications or supplements?

Patient: Yes, I have high blood pressure and I’m taking medication for it, but I don’t have diabetes or known kidney disease. I don’t take heavy NSAIDs, and I haven’t started any new medications or supplements recently.
Have you had any dizziness when standing, salt craving, darkening of your skin, abdominal pain, or diarrhea?
Patient: I haven’t had dizziness when standing or salt cravings, and I haven’t noticed any darkening of my skin. I also don’t have abdominal pain or diarrhea.
Have you had increased thirst, constipation, confusion, or muscle aches/cramps?
Patient: I haven’t had increased thirst, constipation, confusion, or muscle cramps—just the progressive weakness and the about 10 pounds of weight loss over the past two to three months.
Have you had a cough, coughing up blood, chest pain, or any history of smoking?
Patient: I don’t have any cough, I’ve never coughed up blood, and I don’t have chest pain. I don’t smoke, and I haven’t noticed any breathing changes.
Have you had any enlarged lymph nodes, easy bruising, bleeding, or unusual fatigue beyond the weakness?
I haven’t noticed any enlarged lymph nodes, and I don’t bruise or bleed easily. I just feel increasingly fatigued from the weakness, but no other unusual bruising or bleeding.
Have you had any recent kidney imaging or repeat labs, and if so do you know whether your calcium, blood counts, or urine protein were abnormal?

Patient: I haven’t had any kidney imaging recently, and I don’t know if my calcium or blood counts were abnormal. I only know that my repeat labs previously showed elevated BUN and creatinine, and I haven’t had any urine protein testing that I’m aware of.

[ABSTAIN] Insufficient evidence to confidently narrow this further without key labs/imaging.
[POSSIBLE] chronic kidney disease from hypertension, multiple myeloma, occult malignancy causing cachexia with renal dysfunction, renal cell carcinoma, other intrinsic renal disease

predicted_set: occult malignancy causing cachexia with renal dysfunction
